stories.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.explanation: OpenAI has been valued at $1.25 trillion after raising $11 billion in a new funding round. This makes it one of the world's most valuable companies, indicating strong investor confidence in its AI development.

stories.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
stories.explanation: Suno is facing two lawsuits from rights holders of Elvis Presley and Eminem, alleging that its AI music illegally mimics artists' voices and lyrics. The Presley suit claims a violation of Tennessee's ELVIS Act.

stories.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
stories.explanation: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in its systems, focusing on interactions with third-party services and expanding Hacktron's access to frontier models. This initiative aims to strengthen OpenAI's cyber defenses and security.

stories.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
stories.explanation: A new report by METR found Anthropic is using AI to accelerate its own research, leading to models improving twice as quickly. This is significant as it highlights the company's rapid AI development despite its calls for slowing down AI progress.

stories.title: AI Companies Really, Really Want to Buy Your Work Files and Emails
stories.explanation: Data brokers are actively collecting internal corporate files and emails to train AI models, with AI labs reportedly paying significant fees for this private data. This indicates a growing industry for acquiring diverse datasets to enhance AI capabilities.

stories.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
stories.explanation: NVIDIA published a tutorial demonstrating how to optimize FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, achieving up to 4.45x faster image generation. This development aims to improve inference latency for diffusion models in design and visual production workflows.

stories.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
stories.explanation: NVIDIA added four new open-weight checkpoints to its Cosmos 3 model family for interactive world simulation and multi-sensor multi-view driving scenes. These models, including Sim-Bimanual and Sim-Transfer, aim to enhance robotics and autonomous driving development by generating realistic environments.

stories.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
stories.explanation: Concerns are being raised that the US government is approving sales of Nvidia’s AI chips to Chinese firms with ties to blacklisted companies, with one approved firm having an empty office. This raises questions about due diligence in vetting Chinese recipients of H200 AI chips.

stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.explanation: Crusoe sold an unfinished data center project in Wyoming to Google, which plans to invest $17 billion to develop it. This highlights the challenges of building massive AI data centers and Google's continued investment in infrastructure.

stories.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
stories.explanation: The New York Times has added a beta AI-powered recipe modifier feature to its Cooking app, allowing subscribers to swap ingredients or adjust recipes. This aims to help users customize recipes to their needs, despite some initial negative user feedback.
